title: FloodGuard Limit-Increase Premium Returned on Cancellation
content:
### FloodGuard Private Flood Policy — additional premium for limit increases on cancellation

Additional premium charged for limit increases within the 12 months before the cancellation is processed is returned in full when the increase attached fewer than 60 days before the cancellation date; in the share of the calendar days from the cancellation date to the expiration date over the calendar days from the attach date to the expiration date when it attached at least 60 days before the cancellation date; and not at all when no additional premium was charged in that window.

**Reading the premium account**

- The amount in question is the additional premium posted to the premium account as charges for limit increases, counting the charges posted in the 12 months before the day the cancellation is processed; a charge posted before those 12 months is not counted.
- The attach date is the date the limit increase attaches, as recorded on the additional-premium charge.
- The days are calendar days, counted back from the cancellation date to the attach date.

| Additional premium charged in the 12 months | Increase attached before the cancellation date by | Amount returned |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | fewer than 60 days | the whole additional premium |
| Yes | 60 days or more | the additional premium multiplied by the calendar days from the cancellation date to the expiration date, divided by the calendar days from the attach date to the expiration date |
| None | not read | nothing |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical inputs):** an additional premium of 120.00 posted within the 12 months, and a cancellation date 100 days before the expiration date.

- Attached 59 days before the cancellation date: fewer than 60 days, so the whole 120.00 is returned.
- Attached 60 days before the cancellation date: at least 60 days; the attach date lies 160 days before expiration, so 120.00 multiplied by 100 and divided by 160 is returned, which is 75.00.
- Attached 140 days before the cancellation date: 240 days from attach to expiration; 120.00 multiplied by 100 and divided by 240 is 50.00.
- The only additional premium on the account was posted 14 months before the cancellation is processed: nothing was charged in the window, and nothing is returned.
